title: ProjectsGitMergeRequest
description: DD-118: the original Buzz Desktop merge_project_pull_request through BFF. Only when the person's own SERVER key is the repository coordinate owner: Core merges the review's source branch into the target branch in a temporary clone, pushes as that owner (Relay pre-receive policy decides), then publishes the owner-signed original kind 1631 merged status through the existing publication chain. Carries the Idempotency-Key header; the push is keyed by (repository, target ref, old->new) and reconciled from info/refs; 1631 follows DD-81.

expectedCommit.description: Original expected source head; a moved source branch is a conflict, never a silent merge of other commits.
